nom: Sun Bum Baby Bum SPF 50 Sunscreen Face Stick

avis.texte: Works! Reef Safe! Feels great! This stick is only slightly white for a few minutes while applying, which is helpful so you know you didn't miss a spot. Turns clear. My kids didn't mind the application and I enjoyed not putting germs and sand on my kids faces with my hands. No burns after a week long Hawaii vacation!!! Used the baby bum Mineral 50 lotion as well for the body. Both felt great on the skin compared to ALL other mineral sunscreens I have used in the past. Will be using Baby Bum sunscreens only from now on.
Works great stays on great in the water. Also I used it on a three-year-old.

I have 2 small children (3 and 1/5), our youngest has severe eczema and we've struggled to find him a sunscreen that doesn't cause him to have flare ups. After a ton of research I found this product at a local store and decided to try it. It worked fantastic! I was so happy to find a clean product that works for my children for all our future Disney trips!

Bought for baby's first vacation in Florida. This was great for the ears and face. Our girl wasn't a fan of having to rub it in a little after using, but it was great for travel and quick mess free use.
The stick glides on well and rubs in easily. Just be aware it is small. Haven't had a chance to try it in the sun.
Only sun lotion I've used on my son (now 2yo). Never burnt once using the baby bum stick and he LIVES outdoors! Couldn't recommend more!
I love this product. Great for forehead and no sweat dripping in my eyes.
